deinterlace_ranges.reason: Stone-courtyard Four Arms footage visibly combs at source 380. Exact boundary views show footage fades in at 362 and cuts at 391. TFF detail is clean; single-frame field evidence is TFF 13, BFF 0 within the shot.

Cannonbolt and Heatblast footage visibly combs at 420 and 450; both explicit field reconstructions inspected. BFF is supported by 34/42 and 25/33 single-frame classifications. Keep the clean progressive Wildvine shot beginning at 466 unfiltered.

XLR8 spin has strong visible combing at 510; TFF detail has fewer split trails than BFF. Single-frame evidence 498..531 is TFF 17, BFF 8. Include the bright incoming/outgoing transitions; the unambiguously progressive Four Arms shot at 534 remains untouched.

Ben/Heatblast stone-face platform shot has visible combing at 600 and 55 BFF single-frame detections. Exact inspected cut switches to the clean animated logo at 641; that complete graphic card is not deinterlaced.
Ben bridge combat has clear combing on limbs and floor at 855. BFF single-frame evidence 36, TFF 1. Include the incoming picture wipe, and stop before the clean full graphic at 884.

Cannonbolt boss spin has clear interlaced sword/character motion at 975, with 25 BFF and no TFF single-frame detections. The original progressive Wildvine shot starts exactly at 1000 and stays unfiltered.

Four Arms courtyard and XLR8/Cannonbolt cemetery excerpts show obvious combs at 1320, 1380 and 1440. Both field candidates remove combing; BFF is selected for this contiguous source block. Local detectors are mixed, so exact original field chronology is not claimed. Inherited effects trails are preserved, not synthesized away.

Four Arms throw shot has visible combs at 1476. TFF retains a clean continuous back/arm in the inspected comparison and is supported by 21 TFF versus 10 BFF single-frame detections. Exact cuts at 1446 and 1489 were inspected.

Heatblast courtyard footage visibly combs at 1500; 62 BFF single-frame detections with zero TFF support BFF. End in the bright transition before the clean Vilgax-ship footage; the inspected 1590 shot is progressive and remains untouched.

scan_review.decision: Manual picture inspection selects affected shot intervals. Field scores only support parity choices; they do not select intervals. Unselected source frames bypass field reconstruction byte-for-byte before restoration. All title, ratings, package-art and attribution cards remain original progressive pictures. Output is a source-derived candidate; temporal quality and native presentation remain separate checks.
